# ============================================
# FABRIOZA - robots.txt
# SEO + AI Crawler Optimized
# Updated: 2026-07-01
# ============================================

# --- Main Crawlers ---
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /images/
Allow: /videos/
Allow: /blog/
Allow: /custom-*
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /cgi-bin/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /tmp/
Disallow: /*.pdf$
Disallow: /?s=
Disallow: /*?s=

# Attribution-only duplicates of the homepage.
# Every Get a Quote button links to /?from=<that page>#contact so the
# enquiry form knows which page produced the lead. They are the homepage
# and they say so with a canonical, but Google was still crawling 160 of
# them - on a site with 161 real pages that is half the crawl budget spent
# re-reading the homepage. Measured in Search Console 10 Nov 2026 as 89
# URLs under Alternative page with proper canonical tag.
# The parameter must keep working for humans; only crawling stops.
Disallow: /?from=
Disallow: /*?from=

# --- AI Crawlers (GEO Optimization) ---
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: BingBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot
Allow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
Allow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Allow: /

User-agent: DuckAssistBot
Allow: /

# --- Sitemap ---
# Declared FIRST on purpose. The three LLMs pointers below are not
# standard robots.txt directives and Bing's robots.txt Tester reports
# each one as an error (3 errors, 15 Nov 2026). Every major parser
# ignores a directive it does not know, so they are harmless - but a
# parse error sitting ABOVE the Sitemap line is a needless risk on the
# one line that must always be read. Order costs nothing; the risk did.
Sitemap: https://fabrioza.com/sitemap.xml

# --- LLMs.txt Pointer (AI Content Preference) ---
# Commented out, not deleted. No crawler documents reading these keys,
# and llms.txt is discovered at its own root path, which is live:
# https://fabrioza.com/llms.txt and /llms-full.txt both serve 200.
# Uncommenting any line brings its Bing error back with it.
# LLMs: https://fabrioza.com/llms.txt
# LLMs-Full: https://fabrioza.com/llms-full.txt
# AI-Content-Preference: https://fabrioza.com/llms.txt
